newsitem.title: MACAU: Macau tourism jumps 4.6 pct in 9 months of 1996.
newsitem.headline: Macau tourism jumps 4.6 pct in 9 months of 1996.

text.p: Tourist arrivals through the East Asian casino enclave of Macau jumped 4.6 percent in the first nine months of 1996 to reach 6.14 million, the Statistics and Census Department said on Thursday.

Three-quarters of all visitors arrived by sea from Hong Kong and China's Guangdong province, but a growing number had also been coming by air since the territory's international airport opened a year ago.
Two-thirds of all visitors, mostly casino gamblers, were Hong Kong citizens. But the actual number of Hong Kong citizens arriving in Macau fell by 6.9 percent.

But this was offset by a sharp 157 percent rise in visitors from Taiwan, who accounted for 8.61 percent of the total, while visitors from mainland China accounted for 7.18 percent and Japanese visitors 6.17 percent.
